name: Juicy Age
source: Healthy second-year student named Eiji is interested in the opposite sex and often has erotic conversations with his friends. One day, a rumor spreads in class that someone has had their first sexual experience. Eiji and his male friends decide to also have sex, and they choose a classmate named Miki. Eiji discusses it with his classmates and friends, hoping for a good sexual experience. Will this go as planned?
translation: 健康的二年级学生英二对异性感兴趣，经常与朋友进行色情对话。有一天，课堂上流传着一个谣言，说有人有过第一次性经历。英二和他的男性朋友决定也发生性关系，他们选择了一位名叫美木的同学。英二与同学和朋友讨论此事，希望能获得良好的性体验。这会按计划进行吗？
